book.name: iMatiu
book.title: Esɔ Osuse mi abɔ mgbi iMatiu

content: Utsa oga eba okwokyiikwokyi
IYesu diyɛ gbɔdzɛ yi ama mi utsa kpɔɔ gbɛɛ:
<<Esutɔ mgbi Imgbasho dzɛ dafi utɔ nwewo oga eba okwokyiikwokyi ikye ongwan ongyulɔ mani.
O dɔ engbidɔ mgban esɔ mbi ama ngwu a bɔ ma oga ma gbɛɛ nu ma ba, nghaduu a fwa obaaba.

<<Nɛ o diyɛ dɔ engbidɔ angbeka esɔ kpɔɔ gbɛɛ, <Nya ama ngwu ani bɔ ma oga ma gbɛɛ ani ngyɛlu ungwogye okyɔɔkyɔ wa: Mnda mgbi ani ongyulɔ yi mnda olubu-lubu a ngwɔ di kye fwalu ma wa, nɛ alungwɔ duu dzɛ le fɛ-fɛ. Ba oga eba okwokyiikwokyi na.>
<<Kpaa a nu itukwu mi ele ba di lu ungwɔ ma, oka lu okwɔ mgban, oka lu mmya mgban.
Angbeka ama nsisi ma kpali engbidɔ ntona nu ma isɔ di ngwɔlu ma.
Utɔ na si nyɛ yi itingga. O dɔ ogbakwu mgban esɔ ka dzili ama ongwɔ inggisɛ ntona di kye ma ogalu toola.
<<Nɛman o nya engbidɔ mgban gbɛɛ, <Oga eba okwokyiikwokyi nɛ gyɔ wa, ama ngwu ani bɔ ma ma, a mɛ oba ba.
Lu imbe ngwi ofɛ gha, ka bɔ ali inggisɛ ngwu ema tu duu oga nɛni.>
Ta engbidɔ ntona tasɛ lu emi ingɔfɛ ka wulu inggisɛ ngwu ma tu duu, ama osuse yi obube wa yaokɛ, ozu oga byakpa flengba yi ingyoga.
<<Nghaduu ngwi utɔ ba owa kpadi ingyoga nɛta, o dili ongyulɔ oka n wo angwuto oga ba mi ele.
O byita gbɛɛ, <Uka, abu nyɛ ole kaka mmɛnɛ ngwi abu wo angwuto oga ba?> Ongyulɔ na byakpa ndɛ wifwɛ.
<<Nɛ utɔ nya ama ogbe inɛ byi oga gbɛɛ, <Bwalun abɔ yi afɔ, kyon ngwuta lu esɛ mi iifu, imbe ngwi ikwu otseetse bɛyi aba ogyeegye ka dzɛ mani.>
<<Lubana a bɔ inggisɛ kwuba, kpaa li gwee ta ngwi a sadu.>>
Okpa iSidza udza ifyɛɛ
Nghanɛ emi iFarasi tasɛ ka tsɛwɛ ofɛ ngwi ama ka non gbo mi elodzɛ ni ama bwan.

A dɔ engwafɔ mgbi ama bɛyi emidi iHerude esɔ mbon. A gbɛɛ, <<Otsetse, eyi ye abu li inggisɛ oyɛyɛ, abu di li tso ofɛ mgbi Imgbasho mi otsitsi. Inggisɛ li yagba tu abu wo ba ikyekyɛ i kwokyi abu yi odzɛɛdzɛ mgbi ama ba.
Nya eyi ka, abu di sinɛ? Li ola ni eyi kpa iSidza udza ifyɛɛ naadi li ola ba?>>
Nghanɛ iYesu difwi owitukwu mgbi ama obube, nɛ o gbɛɛ, <<Ema emi ikpala ntonɛ, kyɔsinɛ ngwi ema le mina okya ani ukya?
Tso ani iwai awuya ngwi ema li kpa ifyɛɛ ele ma na.>> A kye ikobo mgbi ama ba wa tson,
O byi ma gbɛɛ, <<Li onodzi bɛyi olɔɔlɔ mgbi emɛ dɛn?>>
A nu uka gbɛɛ, <<Li mgbi iSidza.>> O si nya ma gbɛɛ, <<Kye ungwɔ nli mgbi iSidza nu iSidza, di kye ungwɔ mgbi Imgbasho nu Imgbasho.>>
Ngwi a fwo odzɛ nɛ mata ewo fwɛ loma. Man a dzatan lu imbe oka.
Okye ongyaa mi onɔ okyɛɛ mi ikwu
Mi egbe na kpɔɔ, emi iSadusi, ama nli gbɛɛ okyɛɛ mi ikwu dzɛma ba ma, ba mbon yi ita.
A gbɛɛ, <<Otsetse, iMose nya eyi gbɛɛ ni ongyulɔ tu ongwɛ ba ta kwulu yɔ, ni ongwunɔn yile owakwadɛ na kyɛmɛ-kyɛmɛ mban ɛngbɛ.
Engwunɔ ewoma engyulɔ nghi egyafa to yi eyi. Ongwu ababɔ kye ongyaa kpaa kye okwudɛ dzɛ ba man kwulu dzata owan nu ongwu fan.
Ongwu na bɛyi ongwu ta nghataa lu mbi ongwu gyafa duu a tu ongwɛ ba.
Mi ongyɛɛngyɛ yɔ ongyaa na kpaa wa kwulu.
Nghanɛ mi onɔ okyɛɛ mi ikwu ma, o ka li owa emɛ yɛyɛ mi idzidzɛ ama egyafa na, ngwi ama duu kyon?>>
IYesu nu uka gbɛɛ, <<Ema le wɛndɛ, ikyekyɛ ema ye odzɛ ngwi Afɛ gbɔ hona mfye mgbi Imgbasho ba.
Mi onɔ okyɛɛ mi ikwu ma, inggisɛ ka kye ongyaa hona kye ongwɛ nu eba ba; a ka to dafi engyesɔ emi esho mani.
Kpaa mi odzɛ okyɛɛ mi ikwu yɔ, ema gbɔ ungwɔ ngwi Imgbasho nya ema ngwi o gbɛɛ,
<Ani li Imgbasho ngwu Abrahan, Adziki, yi iJeko le sunun mani.> O li Imgbasho mgbi emi ikwukwɔ ba kpaa mgbi emi oshishe.>>
Ngwi inggisɛ ntona fwo otsootso mgban nɛ, i kwulu ma ewo.
Ola onghaangha
Ngwi emi iFarasi fwo gbɛɛ iYesu gbɔdzɛ dzɛ emi iSadusi umyɛ nɛ, a wa kwakye yi ewoma.
Onyi mboma, n ye Ola mgbi emi iJuda saan, mbadin yi ita nɛ gbɛɛ:
<<Otsetse, li Ola ole nghaangha mi Ola duu?>>
IYesu nu uka gbɛɛ, << <Otsɛ Imgbasho mgbi abu no kpa abu yi eka mgbi abu duu, yi oshishe mgbi abu duu, bɛyi itukwu mgbi abu duu.>
Nɛnɛ li ola ongwi ababɔ di nghaangha joni.
Ongwu fan ndzɛ dafi ongwunɛ yɔ, inggisɛ nwatse dɔ abu no kpa abu itukwu dafi ewabu mani.
Ola yi emi Oyegbɔ duu kye abɔ byi ola efa ntonɛni.>>
IKrestu ma li Ongwɛ emɛ
Ngwi emi iFarasi kwakye to mbonyi nɛ, iYesu byi ma gbɛɛ,
<<Ema tsɛwɛ sinɛ mi odzɛ iMedzaya? O li ongwɛ emɛ?>> A gbɛɛ, <<O li Ongwɛ iDevedi.>>
O gbɔ nya ma gbɛɛ, <<I wo sinɛ ngwi iDevedi nose le gbɔdzɛ mi Onodzi se kwun gbɛɛ <Otsɛ>? Bana o gbɛɛ,

content.text: yɛɛ itse mgbi abu ogbe afɔ to ele.>> >

content: Ni iDevedi kwun di <Otsɛ iMedzaya> wali, kyɔsinɛ ngwi o dika li ongwan?>>
Inggisɛ onyi yagba dulu elodzɛ nun uka gbɛ ba, wita mi egbe na lu iyayi inggisɛ onyi fya-fya byun ita wuba.

footnotes.text: Otsɛ ongwu fan nɛ li iMedzaya.
